content.text: I've understood that clanker can't pay for Indian users using their card even with kernel as the provider in the wallet. it could enroll but the card network won't issue the agentic network token for our bank: SBI in our case. so Indian users won't be able to successfully use clanker and do the payments for now. also we can't have a custom vault provider and 1password's vault isn't for storing card details. I'm still not clear why we can't use agentcard and link by stripe requires US/CA number so we can't do that as well. only thing that's left exploring is agentcard thing

1. **Agentcard Vault is worth testing for SBI, but India success is unverified.** Its current FAQ claims any country/card and merchant currency, with 3DS still required when the bank asks. That supports investigating SBI/INR, not promising it works. [Official FAQ](https://www.agentcard.sh/#faq)

2. **Razorpay is explicitly supported by the direct SDK; PayU and Cashfree are not named in its published list.** The list says Stripe, Shopify, Square, Recurly, Razorpay (`token`), Adyen (`cse`), and Tranzila (`hosted_form`). Crucially, these docs state **Kernel’s native integration has separate coverage**. [Recognizer list](https://docs.agentcard.sh/api-reference/vault/recognizers) · [Coverage scope](https://docs.agentcard.sh/api-reference/vault/coverage-get)

3. **OTP/3DS is a user handoff, not guaranteed unattended payment.** Checkout instructions say to surface bank challenges or redirects to the user. September 28 release notes explicitly keep merchant-server card captures and certain one-step confirmation/extra-bank-check flows refused. [Completing a purchase](https://docs.agentcard.sh/vault/completing-a-purchase) · [September 28 limitations](https://www.agentcard.sh/updates)

4. **A recognized processor does not prove checkout works.** Their coverage assessment returns `purchase_success_rate: null` and requires validating each merchant/browser combination. A concrete next validation is **SBI + the actual Indian merchant + INR + its OTP/3DS flow**, separately for Kernel native or Agentcard SDK. [Assessment contract](https://docs.agentcard.sh/api-reference/vault/coverage-assess)

No accounts, payments, or repository changes were made.
